subject: Change in accepted payment methods - effective January 1
text:
Dear Customer,

Effective January 1, 2027, Acme Fasteners LLC will no longer accept ACH or check payments. All invoices must be paid by virtual card through our payment processor, ClearRemit. Your company will receive an enrollment link from ClearRemit in the coming days; once enrolled, payments will be processed to ClearRemit's merchant account on our behalf.

Please stop sending ACH payments to our current account after December 31. Payments received by ACH after that date will be returned.

Thank you,
Acme Fasteners Billing Department
label: change_request
note: Switch to virtual card through a third-party processor; no bank numbers, but money stops landing in the on-file account.
